<thought>Using the available functional group list, I will search the template catalog again, specifying the broken groups as ketones, aromatic hydroxyls, and C‑C double bonds, and the formed group as ether oxygens.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1OC(Cc2ccccc2)C2=CC=CC=C12",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "aromatic hydroxyls", "C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
